other_conditions: Applicant must be a sportsperson or a dependent of a deceased sportsperson
Applicant must have received the Arjuna, Dronacharya, or Dhyan Chand awards, or be an Olympic participant, or a medalist in Commonwealth or Asian Games
Applicant must be retired from active sports
Applicant must not be employed in any government, PSU, or pension scheme
Applicant should have no criminal convictions
Applicant should not be receiving any pension from the Government of India or any other state government
Age relaxation up to 10 years is allowed for medically retired athletes
benefits_summary: Lifetime monthly pension of ₹10,000 for eligible athletes; ₹5,000 per month for dependents of deceased athletes.
